triggers.name: Passive
triggers.summary: Always on. Folded into your stats once at round start, so it costs nothing per tick.

triggers.name: OnHitPlayer
triggers.summary: One of your projectiles hit somebody.

triggers.name: OnBlock
triggers.summary: You pressed block, whether or not anything was deflected.

actions.name: StatMod
actions.label: Change a stat
actions.summary: Modifies one stat. The only action that reads the stat and operation fields.
actions.valueMeans: The amount, meaning whatever the operation makes it mean.

actions.name: ReloadNow
actions.label: Reload now
actions.summary: Refills the magazine on the spot.

actions.name: RefreshBlock
actions.label: Refresh block
actions.summary: Clears the block cooldown so it can be used again straight away.

actions.name: PushNearby
actions.label: Push nearby
actions.summary: Shoves everyone within a radius away from you.

actions.name: PullNearby
actions.label: Pull nearby
actions.summary: Drags everyone within a radius toward you.

actions.name: SpawnRing
actions.label: Spawn a ring
actions.summary: Fires projectiles outward in every direction at once.

actions.name: Blink
actions.label: Blink
actions.summary: Moves you instantly in the direction you are aiming.

actions.name: StunTarget
actions.label: Stun the target
actions.summary: Takes everything away from whoever was hit, briefly.

actions.name: PoisonTarget
actions.label: Poison the target
actions.summary: Damage that arrives after the hit does.

actions.name: CostHealth
actions.label: Cost health
actions.summary: Takes health off you. For cards that charge you to use them.

cards.name: Bullet Time
cards.description: Bullets fly much faster.

cards.name: Buckshot
cards.description: Three bullets, wider spread, less damage each.

cards.name: Bouncy
cards.description: Bullets bounce off the world twice.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.description: Much more damage. Much more recoil.

cards.name: Feather
cards.description: Lighter, floatier, easier to steer in the air.

cards.name: Double Jump
cards.description: One extra jump in the air.

cards.name: Dasher
cards.description: An extra dash, and it recharges faster.

cards.name: Parry
cards.description: Block recovers twice as fast and reflects harder.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.description: Heal for a third of the damage you deal.

cards.name: Glass
cards.description: Far more damage, but you take much more too.

cards.name: Grenadier
cards.description: Bullets arc and explode on impact.

cards.name: Barrage
cards.description: A wall of weak bullets.

cards.name: Combine
cards.description: Twice the damage from half the magazine.

cards.name: Fastball
cards.description: Bullets like lightning, but slow to fire.

cards.name: Spray
cards.description: Absurd rate of fire. Wildly inaccurate.

cards.name: Careful Planning
cards.description: One heavy, slow, deliberate shot.

cards.name: Big Bullet
cards.description: Much larger bullets, much harder to dodge.

cards.name: Quick Reload
cards.description: Back in the fight far sooner.

cards.name: Mayhem
cards.description: Bullets ricochet everywhere.

cards.name: Thruster
cards.description: Bullets stick on and keep pushing. Land more, push harder.

cards.name: Sniper
cards.description: One slow, heavy, perfectly straight shot.

cards.name: Flak
cards.description: A wall of weak shots at close range.

cards.name: Heavy Rounds
cards.description: Fat, slow bullets that hit like a truck.

cards.name: Homewrecker
cards.description: Every shot detonates.

cards.name: Yeeeuge
cards.description: A great deal more health, and a great deal more you.

cards.name: Tank
cards.description: Enormous health, sluggish gun.

cards.name: Glass Cannon
cards.description: Devastating, and made of paper.

cards.name: Regrowth
cards.description: Slowly knit yourself back together.

cards.name: Sprinter
cards.description: Faster on the ground, worse in the air.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.description: You fall like one. Nothing shifts you.

cards.name: Slipstream
cards.description: Firing shoves you along. Ride it.

cards.name: Scavenger
cards.description: Landing a hit reloads your weapon.

cards.name: Taste Of Blood
cards.description: Drawing blood makes you fast.

cards.name: Brawler
cards.description: A hit grants a burst of temporary health.

cards.name: Refresh
cards.description: Dealing damage readies your block again.

cards.name: Venom
cards.description: Bullets poison for several seconds.

cards.name: Cold Bullets
cards.description: Bullets chill whoever they hit.

cards.name: Dazzle
cards.description: Bullets briefly stun.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: A kill heals you handsomely.

cards.name: Shock Wave
cards.description: Blocking hurls everyone away from you.

cards.name: Implode
cards.description: Blocking drags everyone towards you.

cards.name: Overpower
cards.description: Blocking hurts everyone standing near you.

cards.name: Frost Slam
cards.description: Blocking freezes everyone around you.

cards.name: Tactical Reload
cards.description: Blocking reloads your weapon.

cards.name: Teleport
cards.description: Blocking flings you where you are looking.

cards.name: Bombs Away
cards.description: Blocking scatters a ring of shots.

cards.name: Healing Field
cards.description: Blocking mends you.

cards.name: Counterstrike
cards.description: A successful deflection fires back at them.

cards.name: Defender
cards.description: Block far more often, and take more punishment.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.description: Near death, you come back swinging.

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.description: Slow, heavy, and very hard to remove.

cards.name: Thornmail
cards.description: Hurting you costs them.

cards.name: Demonic Pact
cards.description: Shoot constantly. It costs you blood.

cards.name: Radiance
cards.description: Reloading sends a burst of shots outward.

cards.name: Retaliation
cards.description: Being hurt shoves your attacker back.

cards.name: Chilling Presence
cards.description: Everyone near you moves like treacle.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: A kill leaves you fast and shielded.

cards.name: Swarm
cards.description: A ring of shots every time you fire.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.description: Blocking drags the world in and crushes it.
